title: Angle Robustness Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Navigation in GNSS-Denied Scenarios
authors: Wang Y.; Feng Z.; Zhang H.; Gao Y.; Lei J.; Sun L.; Song M.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
